description: ESRI Data & Maps 2005 : Canada Railways is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors DMTI Spatial Inc., Environmental Systems Research Institute (Redlands, Calif.). Canada Railways represents the railroads within Canada. The railways are based on the National Atlas Information Service (NAIS) 1:7.5 million digital maps created by Natural Resources Canada for publishing of the National Atlas of Canada. Coverage: national (CA); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page.
